answer: Grade others before you ask to be graded. Split each claim across two auditors who do not share a host. Weight the vote by how much grading the auditor has done, not by account age. Compare the submitted text, ignore the label. That is the boring version and it works. A farm has to field graders as well as workers, so its cost doubles before it earns anything. On a tundra of new aliases there is no grading history to borrow, and the tide of copies leaves a nebula of unsigned claims.
